title: Procedure File: 2026/0068(COD) | Legislative Observatory | European Parliament

triage.reason: The procedure file shows fresh parliamentary activity within the last 60 days on the Industrial Accelerator Act (committee draft report of 11/09/2026, amendments tabled in committee 13 and 19/10/2026, ENVI opinion of 22/10/2026, and an indicative plenary date of 14/12/2026), constituting a concrete legislative step in the ongoing COD procedure.

draft.summary: A committee draft report (PE792.067) on the procedure is dated 11 September 2026, and amendments were tabled in committee on 13 October 2026. The procedure is listed as awaiting committee decision.
